name: MemVault Memory
description: Persistent cross-session memory for OpenClaw agents, powered by MemVault

userId.description: Default user ID for memory scoping

autoRecall.description: Auto-inject relevant memories before each response

autoCapture.description: Auto-extract and store memories after each response

captureWindowSize.description: Number of recent messages sent for memory extraction on each turn. Larger windows give the LLM more context to understand conversation flow and extract accurate memories. Recommended: 6 (3 rounds). Minimum: 2 (1 round).

topK.description: Max number of memories to recall per turn

sourceApp.description: Source app identifier for tracking memory origin

threshold.description: Minimum similarity score (0-1) for search results filtering

workspacePath.description: Path to OpenClaw workspace directory containing MEMORY.md and memory/ folder. Auto-detected if not set (~/.openclaw/workspace)

memoryMode.description: Memory mode: 'enhance' (MemVault + MEMORY.md as context, default) or 'standalone' (pure MemVault, no local files)

projectId.label: Project ID
projectId.placeholder: 从 MemVault 项目设置中获取

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.placeholder: 在 MemVault 中注册的 Agent ID
